# aip-content-compression-pipeline-store — task plan

**S1 — The decomposer that splits a region into typed parts, and the compositor that puts the parts back. (complete)**
- [x] ac-decompose-parts: A payload with a listing, a grep result and a JSON blob is split into three parts, each with its own kind and a sequential one-based chunk id.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentDecompositor - a named test asserts the part count, the kinds and the chunk ids
- [x] ac-decompose-roundtrip: The template holds every character of the original that is not part of a part, and the compositor puts the original back when no part is reduced.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentCompositor - a test asserts the composed text equals the original when the parts are the original texts
- [x] ac-decompose-unsplittable: A payload that cannot be split by structure stays one part.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentDecompositor - a test asserts a single part for a payload with no structure to find

**S2 — The pure domain model of the compression stage, and the must-keep overlay that closes the decisions-class hole. (complete)**
- [x] ac-overlay-rules: The overlay re-attaches a token the reduction dropped, for each of the five decisions-class rules, with a literal example line per rule.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~MustKeepOverlay - five named tests, one per rule, each asserting the example line's token appears in the overlay block
- [x] ac-overlay-ceiling: The overlay never adds more than five percent of the reduced text, and the decisions-class tokens are the ones that survive the ceiling.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~MustKeepOverlay - a test with a long reduced text and many wanted tokens asserts the block length is within the ceiling and that a verdict token is present while a bare number is not
- [x] ac-overlay-subset: The overlay adds tokens only, and never rewrites the reduced text.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~MustKeepOverlay - a test asserts the reduced text is a prefix of the result and the appended block holds only tokens found in the original

**S3 — One compression handler per payload kind, each reducing to a subset of its input. (complete)**
- [x] ac-log-503: The log reducer keeps the status=503 line whose level is INFO, and keeps two anchors at each end.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~LogCompressionHandler - a named test asserts the status=503 line survives and a middle INFO line without a signal does not
- [x] ac-json-scale: The JSON reducer compacts the document and keeps the scale of a number.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~JsonCompressionHandler - a test asserts 49.90 is present in the compacted output and the whitespace is gone
- [x] ac-subset: Every reducing handler returns text whose lines are all lines of the input, so the reduction never invents a word.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~CompressionHandler - one test per handler asserting the subset property, the reduction's own line list is a subset of the input's
- [x] ac-handler-count: At least five handlers exist and each one claims exactly the kinds it says it does.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~CompressionHandler - a test enumerates the handlers and asserts the claimed kinds per handler

**S4 — The finder that locates the tool output in a request body, without touching anything else. (complete)**
- [x] ac-regions-shapes: The finder finds the tool output in the three envelope shapes and returns its byte span.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ToolOutputRegionFinder - three named tests, one per shape, each asserting the span covers the tool output and nothing else
- [x] ac-regions-precision: A string elsewhere in the body with the same content as a tool output is not a region.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ToolOutputRegionFinder - a test with the same text in a user message and in a tool result asserts exactly one region
- [x] ac-regions-none: A body that is not JSON, or that carries no tool output, yields no regions.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ToolOutputRegionFinder - two named tests, one for a plain-text body and one for a JSON body with no tool output

**S5 — The router that picks the handler for a part, and the executor that runs it. (complete)**
- [x] ac-router-claim: The router picks the handler that claims the kind, and the pass-through handler takes a kind nobody claims.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentRouter - two named tests, one for a claimed kind and one for an unclaimed kind
- [x] ac-executor-ratio: The executor reports the ratio of the compressed text to the original text, and the path the handler declared.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~CompressionExecutor - a test asserts the ratio against a hand-computed value and the path string

**S6 — The pipeline that implements the existing ICompressionPipeline seam and writes the record to the store. (complete)**
- [x] ac-pipeline-bytes: The bytes outside the region spans are exactly what the client sent, and the region carries the reduced text.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentCompressionPipeline - a test asserts the prefix and the suffix around the region are byte-identical to the input and the region is shorter
- [x] ac-pipeline-record: The record the store receives carries the original, the compressed text, the ratio, the path and the chunk count, and the chunk count equals the number of parts.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentCompressionPipeline - a test with a fake store asserts the record's fields against hand-computed values
- [x] ac-pipeline-unchanged: A body with no tool output is forwarded unchanged, and the store is not called.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentCompressionPipeline - a test asserts Changed is false and the fake store was not called

**S7 — The SQLite adapter that keeps the original, the compressed text, the ratio and the path. (complete)**
- [x] ac-store-roundtrip: A record written to a real database file comes back with the same original, the same compressed text, the same ratio, the same path and the same parts.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~SqliteContentStore - a test against a temporary database file asserts the round trip field by field
- [x] ac-store-unknown: An unknown request id returns null.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~SqliteContentStore - a test asserts null for an id that was never written
- [x] ac-store-wal: The database runs in WAL mode, so a reader and a writer do not block each other.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~SqliteContentStore - a test opens a second connection, writes on one and reads on the other, and asserts the read sees the committed row

**S8 — The queue that carries the record to the writer, and the worker that drains it. (complete)**
- [x] ac-queue-durable: A queued job is still in the queue when the producer returns, so the record survives the process dying before the worker runs.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentQueue - a test reads the queue table straight from the database after the producer returns and asserts the row is there
- [x] ac-worker-drains: The worker drains a queued job and writes the content rows.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentStoreWorker - a test calls RunOnceAsync and asserts the content row exists and the queue row is gone
- [x] ac-worker-retry: A job that fails stays in the queue and is retried on the next pass.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentStoreWorker - a test makes the store fail once, runs the pass twice and asserts the job is still queued after the first pass and gone after the second
- [x] ac-worker-dataversion: The worker asks for the pragma before it queries, so the poll is not a blind timer.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentStoreWorker - a test counts the store's read calls across two passes with no new job and asserts the second pass made no read

**S9 — The host wiring, the configuration, the retrieval endpoint, and the test that proves the whole thing end to end. (complete)**
- [x] ac-host-one-pipeline: Exactly one ICompressionPipeline is registered, and it is the compressing one when the stage is on.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ProxyApplication - a test resolves ICompressionPipeline from the container and asserts the type, and a second test asserts the pass-through when the stage is off
- [x] ac-host-e2e: A request whose body carries a tool result is forwarded with the reduced text, the rest of the body is byte-identical, and the original is retrievable by the request id.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentCompression - an integration test through ProxyHost asserts the forwarded body against the expected bytes and then reads the retrieval endpoint
- [x] ac-host-unknown-id: An unknown request id is answered with a problem details response and not with an empty body.
  - check: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~ContentCompression - an integration test asserts the status code and the problem details content type
